Sketch.rule: Must start with SK_, followed by the descriptive feature name in PascalCase.

Pad.rule: Must start with PD_, representing extruded 3D solid bodies.

Pocket.rule: Must start with PK_, representing subtracted material or dado grooves.

Part.rule: Sub-assemblies or container parts must start with ASM_.

general_guidelines: Never leave default generic names like Pad001, Sketch002, or Pocket0. Always use descriptive functional names.
